definitions.gloss: Calpis, a sweet, milky soft drink
definitions.explanation: A Japanese soft drink with a sweet-sour, milky taste, made from fermented skim milk and first sold in 1919. Sold as a concentrate to dilute with water, and ready to drink as カルピスウォーター.

examples.japanese: カルピス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
カルピス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{薄|うす}める→薄める：10055_usumeru⟧。

⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦おばあちゃん→おばあちゃん：10968_obaachan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{飲|の}んだ→飲む：00322_nomu⟧カルピス⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{忘|わす}れられない→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: I can't forget the taste of the Calpis I drank at my grandmother's house during summer vacation.

notes:
A drink with a strong nostalgic image of childhood summers in Japan. The concentrate is mixed with water, milk or soda; カルピス⟦ソーダ→ソーダ：11032_sooda⟧ is the fizzy version.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- カルピス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{薄|うす}める→薄める：10055_usumeru⟧ / ⟦{割|わ}る→割る：02334_waru⟧: to dilute Calpis
- カルピスウォーター: ready-to-drink Calpis
- {濃|こ}いめ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧カルピス: Calpis mixed strong

CULTURAL NOTE:
It is sold abroad under the name Calpico.
